newsitem.title: USA: N.J. school funding bill set for debate - paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. school funding bill set for debate - paper.

text.p: New Jersey lawmakers, under a court-imposed Dec 31 deadline for devising a new school funding plan, have prepared a schedule for legislative action, the Star Ledger reported Tuesday.
Senate Education Committee Chairman Jack Ewing plans to discuss a bill Thursday designed to meet the court's mandate for equalization of spending between the state's rich and poor districts.
A possible committee vote could come Nov 18, the newspaper said. The full Senate reconvenes on Nov 25, when it may consider the bill.
Gov Christine Whitman has proposed her own plan to require that $7,200 per pupil be spent, a minimum that would be constitutionally guaranteed.
